caption_L1: Number of Toyota cars sold in Norway from 2009 to 2019 is a area plot. There is a linear scale of range 2010 to 2018 on the x-axis, marked Year. The y-axis shows Units sold.
caption_L2L3: Over the 10 years from 2009-2019, Toyota sold over 15,000 cars in Norway each year. Sales were particularly high in 2010, 2013 and 2017. Sales from 2017-2019 have remained static at approximately 15,000 per year.
L1_properties: Number of Toyota cars sold in Norway from 2009 to 2019
